UpdateSourceArgs: -NoProfile -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; [Net.ServicePointManager]::SecurityProtocol = [Net.SecurityProtocolType]::Tls12; Set-Location -Path '{{$FullBaseDir}}server'; $Url='{{SpecificBuildVersionURL}}'; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Url)) { $Page = (Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri 'https://docs.fivem.net/docs/server-download/?platform=enhanced&os=windows').Content; $Url = [regex]::Match($Page, 'https://cfx-downloads.akamaized.net/prod/[A-Za-z0-9-]+/cfx-server_win_x64.zip').Value }; if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($Url)) { Write-Output 'Could not find the server download URL'; exit 1 }; Write-Output \"Downloading $Url\"; Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri $Url -OutFile 'cfx-server.zip'; if (-not $?) { exit 1 }; Expand-Archive -Path 'cfx-server.zip' -DestinationPath '.' -Force; if (-not $?) { exit 1 }; Remove-Item -Force 'cfx-server.zip'"

-c "cd \"{{$FullBaseDir}}server\" || exit 1; Url=\"{{SpecificBuildVersionURL}}\"; if [[ -z \"$Url\" ]]; then Url=$(wget -qO- 'https://docs.fivem.net/docs/server-download/?platform=enhanced&os=linux' | grep -oE 'https://cfx-downloads.akamaized.net/prod/[A-Za-z0-9-]+/cfx-server_linux_x64.tar.xz' | head -n1); fi; if [[ -z \"$Url\" ]]; then echo 'Could not find the server download URL'; exit 1; fi; echo \"Downloading $Url\"; wget -qO cfx-server.tar.xz \"$Url\" || exit 1; rm -rf alpine; tar -xf cfx-server.tar.xz || exit 1; rm -f cfx-server.tar.xz"
